node: Naval, submarine, and subsea niche components
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for naval/submarine/subsea niche components with a two-lane funnel. Reference context is Leonardo DRS, a larger listed naval power and propulsion supplier tied directly to Columbia-class submarine propulsion. The underfollowed lane surfaces Graham Corporation as a small-cap defense/process-equipment supplier with explicit Navy submarine program exposure. Two below-$300M speculative exceptions, Coda Octopus and Taylor Devices, are included because their public disclosures point to unusually direct niche exposure in underwater sonar/DAVD and submarine shock-isolation components, respectively. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
